name: Shirogane College
description: Shirogane College is a veterinary nursing college founded in 2004 at 14 Linden Yard, Ashbourne Vale. The site sets out the two-year Diploma in Veterinary Nursing, the foundation certificate and the evening course, with the teaching ward, a training day from 07:45 to 17:00, and admissions for the February 2027 intake. It speaks plainly to career changers, school leavers, clinic staff, supporters and partner clinics. A pine panel with a hexagon point sits beside a cross-dissolving set of ward photographs; a sticky-photo training day, a honeycomb of six course hexagons and a parallax ward band follow. Typography is Manrope and Source Sans 3.
